text: My office has received a petition by residents on Eastwood Road looking to reinstate on-street parking on the south side

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized parking by permit only, on an area name basis, within area 9C, from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m. daily on the odd side of Eastwood Road, between Eastwood Road (north/south branch) and Woodbine Avenue 2. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Eastwood Road between a point 36 metres west of Bowmore Road and a point 30 metres west of Woodbine Avenue. 3. Prohibited parking at all times on the east and south side of Eastwood Road, between a point 36 metres west of Bowmore Road and a point 35.5 metres east of Eastwood Road (north/south branch). 4. Prohibited parking at all times on the south side of Eastwood Road, between a point 50.5 metres east of Eastwood Road (north/south branch) and a point 30 metres west of Woodbine Avenue.
